author: TragikBolt
body: Hey. Avicus, I am very sorry for what i did, can i please come back on the server. I promise i will never do what I did before. I should have been way nicer and not rude. I am so very sorry to who I was mean to. I am sorry for griefing anybody and for bad language. Can you please give me one more chance and let me on the server?

replies.author: rinn
replies.body:
Hello hdbolt,

Considering you have spent 6 months banned, I will appeal your infraction and allow you back onto the server. However, since you have acquired many infractions, if current staff members see that you begin breaking rules again, they possess the power to permanently ban you once again and deny you the chance to appeal. That being said, welcome back to the server and be sure to re-read the rules, which can be easily accessed on the forums or in-game. If you have any questions, ask a staff member. Good luck!

Thanks,
rinn
